Generated plan-007 includes safety-netting but also adds difficulty passing urine and slightly different wording; fu-001 specifically being in Follow_up_Information as phrased is not mirrored exactly, and recurrent episodes clause is separately in fu-001 (gen) about arranging review, not direct contact as in gold. So the precise follow-up instruction is only partially represented and thus treated as omitted.
